code: import axiosInstance from"core/services/api/axiosInstance";const base_url=process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL;const API_URL=`${base_url}disbursement-setups`;const getDisbursements=async access_token=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${access_token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.get(API_URL,config);return response.data;};const deleteDisbursement=async(disbursementId,token)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.delete(API_URL+"/"+disbursementId,config);return response.data;};const updateDisbursement=async(disbursementId,disbursementData,token)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.put(API_URL+"/"+disbursementId,disbursementData,config);return response.data;};const createDisbursement=async(disbursementData,token)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.post(API_URL,disbursementData,config);return response.data;};const disbursementService={createDisbursement,getDisbursements,deleteDisbursement,updateDisbursement};export default disbursementService;
